question: In beginningless existence is there even an atom — what order for future prior-absence?
premises: not even an atom exists in beginningless existence
what now this order — of future, prior-absence of knowledge
inference: Beginninglessness leaves no atom; future-knowledge prior-absence ordering questioned.
plain_english: Not even an atom exists in existence, indeed in this beginningless — what now this order? Of future, prior-absence of knowledge, established being.
